objects.description: [DarkGate](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1111) relies on parent PID spoofing as part of its "rootkit-like" functionality to evade detection via Task Manager or Process Explorer.(Citation: Trellix Darkgate 2023)
objects.description_fa: [DarkGate](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1111) برای فرار از شناسایی از طریق Task Manager یا Process Explorer به جعل PID والد به عنوان بخشی از عملکرد "rootkit-مانند" متکی است.(Citation: Trellix Darkgate 2023)
